I am humbled by the passion and clarity of this young lady.
She is, after all, living at ground zero to see the climatic changes to her country, and seeing the immediate danger we are all in...
#ClimateCrisis #BeAClimateChanger

When you are care about your children more than yourself, when you defy someone/something overwehlming bigger than you are....

Which is why we have to support #ClimateChange. For all our species from bird eggs to human beings...we are all in this together.
